judged_text: Post#cook short-circuits with 'return raw' when cook_method is raw_html, placing the return ahead of both post_analyzer.cook (the markdown + Sanitize pipeline that neutralizes script/javascript: URLs in every other post) and Plugin::Filter.apply(:after_post_cook, ...), so raw_html posts are stored and served as verbatim HTML. The unsanitized external HTML this same PR imports (TopicEmbed.import) reaches <%= raw post.cooked %> at app/views/embed/best.html.erb:19 and the main topic renderer as executable markup, turning the import feature into a stored-XSS pipeline; plugins registering after_post_cook filters are silently bypassed too.

adjudication.rationale: The diff adds Post.cook_methods with :raw_html and changes Post#cook to `return raw if cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`, which bypasses both `post_analyzer.cook(*args)` (the normal markdown/sanitization pipeline) and `Plugin::Filter.apply(:after_post_cook, ...)` (lib/app/models/post.rb). The same PR imports external HTML into posts via TopicEmbed.import/import_remote without any sanitization shown here (RSS `i.content` and Readability `doc.content`), and then renders it with `<%= raw post.cooked %>` in app/views/embed/best.html.erb. Given the early return, raw_html posts can be served as verbatim, executable HTML and also skip after_post_cook plugin filters, matching the finding’s stored-XSS and plugin-bypass concerns.
